[NSEC 2025 — solutions]
5. Pale lilac colour is characteristic of f-block elements not of p block. Also, f block elements do not have
significant crystal fields effects, so the trihalides may have same colour. Also, AsF 3 would be a gas.
Therefore, central atom is Nd. Nd +3 is a hard weak acid owing to which its fluoride will be insoluble, but
its other halides are expected to be soluble. Dark greenish black colour in D is due to the charge transfer
from I . Therefore, halides are F , Cl , Br , I respectively. - - - - -
Ans: d

the 4f and 5f sub-shell respectively.

states.
